notes.title: Thank You! 🎉 Feedback Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686519/ebf1d439b831e8085a2dc93a178ff26bfa8a3437.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey Champs! 🥊[/p][p]We just hit [b]100 wishlists[/b] and crossed [b]900+ downloads[/b] on the demo — thank you all so much for playing, sharing, and leaving feedback. We’re honestly blown away by the support 💥[/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your input across Twitter, TikTok, Discord, Reddit, and Steam — and we’re already deep in the lab working on an update to the demo.[/p][p]Here are just a few of the areas we’re focusing on:[/p][list][*][p]Improving [b]fighter visuals[/b], animations, and feel[/p][/*][*][p]Making [b]camera movement[/b] more comfortable in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Updating [b]audio[/b] and impact feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothing out [b]controls[/b] and adding better movement cues[/p][/*][*][p]Exploring [b]replayability[/b] with more variety on the horizon 👀[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be sharing an [b]official changelist soon[/b], but just know the next version is already cooking and your feedback is helping shape what comes next. 💪[/p][p]Thanks again for stepping into the ring with us.
🧡 The Punch Champs Team[/p]
